purpose: Semantic color roles for original RNG Clothing palettes. Roles describe function, not fixed rarity or hue.

colorSpaceGuidance.workingModel: perceptual lightness and hue relationships should be evaluated in OKLCH or an equivalent perceptual space during implementation
colorSpaceGuidance.warning: Numeric ranges are validation guidance, not automatic palette generation rules. Worn-scale review remains authoritative.

DeepShadow.function: deepest recess and selected contour anchor
DeepShadow.lightnessGuidance: very dark but not obligatorily black
DeepShadow.hueGuidance: may shift cooler, warmer, or more chromatic than the primary fabric according to story

StructuralDark.function: construction-defining dark shared by seams, layer boundaries, cuffs, pockets, and controlled contours
StructuralDark.lightnessGuidance: clearly separated from primary midtone while remaining less severe than DeepShadow
StructuralDark.hueGuidance: should harmonize across multiple fabrics; a small shared-dark library is encouraged
forbiddenUses: automatic one-pixel outline around all opaque pixels

PrimaryFabric.lightnessGuidance: may be light, middle, or dark; batch composition must vary
PrimaryFabric.hueGuidance: defines the story but never implies rarity
forbiddenUses: being selected only from masculine/military dark hues

PrimaryFabricLight.function: light-facing plane or restrained highlight for the primary fabric
PrimaryFabricLight.hueGuidance: may shift warmer under warm light or cooler for icy/synthetic stories

SecondaryFabric.function: meaningful second fabric or inner/outer layer
SecondaryFabric.lightnessGuidance: must separate from PrimaryFabric by value, hue, or both
SecondaryFabric.hueGuidance: supports construction topology rather than filling a default center stripe
forbiddenUses: thin central decoration falsely labeled as an inner layer

SecondaryFabricLight.function: light-facing plane for a substantial second fabric
SecondaryFabricLight.lightnessGuidance: consistent with the second material's own ramp
SecondaryFabricLight.hueGuidance: need not share the primary highlight hue
forbiddenUses: creating an unnecessary second ramp for tiny accents

Trim.lightnessGuidance: readable against adjacent fabric without becoming the dominant focal color
Trim.hueGuidance: often neutral or closely related to one fabric
forbiddenUses: competing with Accent at every edge

Accent.lightnessGuidance: must remain distinguishable at gameplay scale
Accent.hueGuidance: may carry the highest saturation or strongest temperature contrast

OptionalMotif.function: original motif or emblem-like cluster distinct from construction
OptionalMotif.lightnessGuidance: must separate from its host field with a compact readable cluster
OptionalMotif.hueGuidance: may reuse Accent, Trim, or a quieter dedicated tone
forbiddenUses: motif used to rescue weak article identity

OptionalMetal.lightnessGuidance: one dark/mid or mid/light relationship is enough
OptionalMetal.hueGuidance: warm brass, cool silver, dark gunmetal, or story-specific metal

globalConstraints: Role count follows garment needs; unused roles must remain absent rather than filled artificially.
DeepShadow and StructuralDark may be shared across fabric ramps when this improves cohesion.
PrimaryFabric may occupy any dominant value band; light-primary is fully supported.
Accent and OptionalMetal are independent of rarity.
Color roles never override construction topology or body-coverage rules.
Final contrast is evaluated on the worn Farmer at gameplay scale.
